quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Deus vero illud signum dicitur quod contra hoc signum in diametro fuerit constitutum, id est IX. ab horoscopo signum
quotations.translation: Deus is the name of the place which is diametrically opposite this place, that is the ninth from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: XVI. DE QUATTUOR SECUNDIS LOCIS
quotations.translation: XVI. ON THE FOUR FOLLOWING (FAVORABLE) PLACES
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Deus vero illud signum dicitur quod contra hoc signum in diametro fuerit constitutum, id est IX. ab horoscopo signum
quotations.translation: Deus is the name of the house which is diametrically opposite this house, that is the ninth from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Bona Fortuna in quinto ab horoscopo signo collocatur;
quotations.translation: Good fortune is located in the fifth sign from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Bonus vero Daemon in diametro huius signi collocatur, id est in XI. ab horoscopo loco;
quotations.translation: The Bonus Daemon is located diametrically opposite this house, that is, in the eleventh house from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Residua quattuor loca pigra et deiecta esse dicuntur ob hoc quod nulla cum horoscopo societate iunguntur.
quotations.translation: The remaining four houses are all feeble and debilitated because of the fact that they are not aspected to the ascendant.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Residua quattuor loca pigra et deiecta esse dicuntur ob hoc quod nulla cum horoscopo societate iunguntur.
quotations.translation: The remaining four houses are all feeble and debilitated because of the fact that they are not aspected to the ascendant.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Est autem ex his residuis quattuor locis primus, qui in secundo ab horoscopo signo constituitur: qui locus Inferna Porta dicitur vel Anafora
quotations.translation: The first of thses remaining four places, however, which is located in the second place from the ascendant, is called the Gate of Hell, or the Anafora (rising up from the Underworld)
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Est autem ex his residuis quattuor locis primus, qui in secundo ab horoscopo signo constituitur: qui locus Inferna Porta dicitur vel Anafora
quotations.translation: The first of thses remaining four places, however, which is located in the second place from the ascendant, is called the Gate of Hell, or the Anafora (rising up from the Underworld)
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: in diametro huius signi locus qui fuerit, id est in VIII. ab horoscopo signo, Epicatafora appellatur
quotations.translation: The place which is diametrically opposite to this place, that is, the eighth from the ascendant, is called the Epicatafora
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: et Mala Fortuna in VI. ab horoscopo signo constituitur.
quotations.translation: and Bad fortune is located in the sixth sign from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: sed Malam fortunam Graeci cacen tychen appellant
quotations.translation: but Bad fortune the Greeks call κακὴν τύχην
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Malus vero Daemon in XII. ab horoscopo signo ponitur
quotations.translation: but the Malus Daemon is located in the twelfth sign from the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Malum daemonem [...] cacodaemonem Graeci vocant
quotations.translation: The bad daemon the Greeks call cacodaemon
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: respicere enim horoscopum de exagono videtur.
quotations.translation: it seems to be aspected in sextile to the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: respicere enim horoscopum de exagono videtur.
quotations.translation: it seems to be aspected in sextile to the ascendant
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: quia de quadrato horoscopum respicit et per quadratum ab horoscopo videtur.
quotations.translation: because it influence the ascendant in square aspect and is influenced by it in square
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In hoc loco Medium Caelum frequenter partiliter invenitur
quotations.translation: The MC is often found in exact conjunction with this house
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Appellatur autem hic locus a nobis Bonus Daemon vel Bonus Genius
quotations.translation: This house is called by us Bonus Daemon or Bonus Genius
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: His locus a Graecis cacos daemon appellatur
quotations.translation: This house is called by the Greeks κακὸς δαίμων
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Quemcumque enim locum benivolae stellae respexerint, [...] omnia [...] feliciter proueniunt
quotations.translation: For when the benefic planets are in aspect [...] all the things [...] turn out well
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Scire etiam debemus quod sit dextrum trigonum, quod sinistrum. Dextrum trigonum est quod ab eo signo, a quo incipimus, retro est, sinistrum vero, quod abante; utputa Arietis dextrum trigonum est Sagittarius, sinistrum vero Leo
quotations.translation: We must know too which is a right and which is a left trine. The right trine is that which is back of the sign from which we begin, the left trine is the one ahead. So, for instance, the right trine of Aries is Sagittarius, the left is Leo
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Scire etiam debemus quod sit dextrum trigonum, quod sinistrum. Dextrum trigonum est quod ab eo signo, a quo incipimus, retro est, sinistrum vero, quod abante; utputa Arietis dextrum trigonum est Sagittarius, sinistrum vero Leo
quotations.translation: We must know too which is a right and which is a left trine. The right trine is that which is back of the sign from which we begin, the left trine is the one ahead. So, for instance, the right trine of Aries is Sagittarius, the left is Leo
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Ac per hoc, quodcumque signum extra hunc numerum fuerit inuentum, pigrum et ableptum dicitur.
quotations.translation: And, because of this, whatever sign is found outside of this number is called passive and ableptum.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Cum datorem vitae diligenter inspexeris, id est dominum geniturae, [...]
quotations.translation: If you look closely at the giver of life, i. e. the ruler of the chart [...]
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Cum datorem vitae diligenter inspexeris, id est dominum geniturae, [...]
quotations.translation: If you look closely at the giver of life, i. e. the ruler of the chart [...]
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si itaque dominus vitae, vel dator vitae, id est dominus geniturae, in domo sua vel in altitudine sua uel finibus suis fuerit [...]
quotations.translation: If the Ruler of Life or the Giver of Life, that is the ruler of the nativity, is in his own house or in his own exaltation or in his own terms [...]
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Cum itaque Sol dominus temporum fuerit, tenet dominatum annos decem menses novem; simili modo et Luna, cum domina temporis fuerit, tenebit annos decem menses novem.
quotations.translation: Thus when the Sun is the Ruler of Time he holds dominion for ten years and nine months. In a similar way the Moon, when she becomes Mistress of Time, will hold it for ten years and nine months.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Chronocratorem dixerunt Graeci temporum dominum;
quotations.translation: The Greeks call the Ruler of Time Chronocrator
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Gemini in Cancrum antiscium mittunt et Cancer in Geminos
quotations.translation: Gemini send antiscia toward Cancer and Cancer toward Gemini
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si quae se itaque stellae in ordinatione geniturae non viderint, quaerendum est an sibi per antiscium sociata radiatione iungantur.
quotations.translation: Thus if, in computing the chart, some of the planets are not in aspect, it must be asked whether they are connected to each other through the relationship of the antiscia.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: in hoc signo, in quo humiliatur atque deicitur
quotations.translation: in this sign, in which it is in fall
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: in Occasu posita, violenta Martis radiatione pulsetur.
quotations.translation: located in the descendant, it is badly aspected with Mars
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: id est in domo Saturni, et Saturnis in domo Mercurii, commutatis invicem domibus, absconsarum litterarum scium faciunt
quotations.translation: located in the sign of Saturn, and Saturn in the sign of Mercury—their signs are in mutual reception—and this made the native knowledgeable of arcane literature
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: doctrinam etiam et tantam litterarum scientiam immutatis domibus Saturnus Mercuriusque decreverunt
quotations.translation: Such learning and knowledge are also decreed by Mercury and Saturn when their signs are interchanged
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original:
दिनं चतुःषष्टिलवोनमाहुस्तिथिं युशब्दान्त्यमहस्तु सर्वम् ।
त्रिषष्टिभागेनयुतं सहस्रं युगेवमानामपसप्तषट्कम् ॥५॥
quotations.transliteration:
dinaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭi-lavônam āhus tithiṃ yuśabdāntyam ahas tu sarvam |
triṣaṣṭibhāgena yutaṃ sahasraṃ yuge 'vamānām apasaptaṣaṭkam |5|
quotations.translation:
They say that a day minus 1/64th is a tithi whereas a whole (day) is (a tithi)
plus 1/63rd. The omitted (tithis) in a yuga are 1.000 minus 7 x 6. |5|
quotations.publication: Mak, B., 2013. The date and nature of Sphujidhvaja’s Yavanajātaka reconsidered in the light of some newly discovered materials, History of Science in South Asia 1: 1-20.

quotations.original: [… ana(?) ŠEG3 u IL]LU ME.A GAR-an | […] iti.GU₄ ša₂ MUL₂-GAL 1.12 24 12 MU.AN.NA.MEŠ | [ša2 d.Dil-bat] 16 8 MU.MEŠ ša₂ d.GU₄.UD 46 21 13 MU.MEŠ | [ša2 d.SAG.UŠ … ša2 d.Ṣal-bat-a-nu] 47 MU.MEŠ ša₂ d.UTU 36 54 MU.MEŠ ša₂ d.30 18 MU.MEŠ
quotations.translation: [If] you (want to) cast a prediction [for…rain and] flood: | […] month II. For Jupiter 72, 24, 12 years, | [for Venus] 16, 8 years, for Mercury 46, 21, 13 years, | [for Saturn …, for Mars] 47 years, for the sun 36, 54 years, for the moon 18 years.
quotations.publication: Hunger, H. 1976. Astrologische Wettervorhersagen. Zeitschrift fur Assyriologie 66

quotations.original: ἐὰν δέ ποτε οἱ τῶν ἀχρηματίστων τόπων δεσπόται ἐπὶ τῶν χρηματιστικῶν τόπων τύχωσι, μετριότητα βίου δηλοῦσιν
quotations.translation: If the masters of the inactive places happen to be at active places, they show a moderate livelihood.

quotations.original: διὸ οἰκοδεσποτήσει τὸ διάθε̣μα
quotations.translation: Therefore it (Mercury) will be the house-master of the (natal) chart.

quotations.original: GE6 9 USAN2 lu2.TUR GUD(?) x x
quotations.translation: Night of the 9th, evening watch, the child ... .
quotations.date: 2nd century BCE (Date of birth in horoscope: S.E. 109 XI.9 = -201 Feb.4)
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88, 1–164.

quotations.original: οἷον ἐπὶ τοῦ Κρόνου τῶν μοιρῶν τὰς διαμετρούσας θεωρεῖν τίνος εἰσὶ θεοῦ, καθὼς ἐν τῷ ὀργάνῳ πρόκειται
quotations.translation: Such as, in the case of the degrees of Saturn, one is to observe the (degrees) in opposition, which god’s they are, as is set out in the instrument (i.e., table).
quotations.publication: (GH L 61,X)

quotations.original: οἷον ἐπὶ τοῦ Κρόνου τῶν μοιρῶν τὰς διαμετρούσας θεωρεῖν τίνος εἰσὶ θεοῦ, καθὼς ἐν τῷ ὀργάνῳ πρόκειται
quotations.translation: Such as, in the case of the degrees of Saturn, one is to observe the (degrees) in opposition, which god’s they are, as is set out in the instrument (i.e., table).
quotations.publication: (GH L 61,X)

quotations.original: οἷον ἔστω Κρόνος Καρκίνου μοίρᾳ καʹ ὁρίοις Ἀφροδίτης, διάμετρος Αἰγοκέρωτι ὁρίοις Ἄρεως· Ἄρης Ταύρου μοίρᾳ κζʹ. ἐνθάδε Κρόνου ὄντος ἀποθανεῖται Παρθένῳ· τὸ γὰρ μοιρικὸν τετράγωνον τοῦτο.
quotations.translation: For example, let Saturn be in degree 21 of Cancer, the terms of Venus, in opposition to Capricorn in the terms of Mars; Mars in degree 27 of Taurus; Saturn being there, (the native) will die in Virgo, for this is the square with respect to degrees.
quotations.publication: (GH L 61,X)

quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.translation: Month IX 1, | [on the 27th(?) day], middle of night, the child | [was born].

quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.original: [it]i.NE 30 GE6 4 SAG GE6 30 | SIG SA4 ša2 ABSIN 1 5/6 KUŠ3 30 1/2 KUŠ3 | ana NIM DIB U4.4.KAM LU2 a-lid
quotations.translation: [Mon]th V 30, night of the 4th, beginning of night, the moon was | below the bright star of the Furrow (= a Virginis) by 1 5/6 cubits, the moon passed 1/2 cubit | to the east. On the 4th day the child was born.
quotations.date: 3rd(-2nd?) century BCE (date of birth in horoscope: S.E. 88 V.4 = -223 July 29)
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.original:
(17) ki-i si-man ša₂ GI₆.[DU al-la LA₂ ša₂ GI₆ DIRI LA₂ ša₂ GI₆ TA GI₆ DU NIM]
(18) ša₂ TAG₄ ⸢TA 6 LA₂ 1-en⸣ ME TAB
quotations.translation: (17) If the time by which the night has progressed exceeds the length of night, you deduct the length of night from (the time by which) the night has progressed. (18) What remains you subtract from 6,0. You add 1 day.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original:
(37) 1.30 ana KUR šamaš₂ re-ḫi 1.30 ina 6 12 DANNA E₁₁-ma 4.30 IB₂.TAG₄ 
(38) U₄.28.KAM
quotations.translation: (37) 1,30 remains until sunrise. You deduct 1,30 from 6,0 (UŠ, i.e.) 12 bēru, 4,30 is the remainder (38) of day 28.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original:
(18) ša₂ GENNA TA 10 A EN 30 GU TUR-tu₂
(19) TA 30 GU EN 10 A GAL-tu₂
quotations.translation: (18) For Saturn. From 10 Leo until 30 Aquarius the small one; (19) from 30 Aquarius until 10 Leo the large one.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver 2012 No. 42

quotations.original: MU.1.ME.58.KAM | iti.GAN GE6 27 ina MURUB4-ti3 | lu2.TUR a-lid
quotations.translation: Year 158 (S.E.), | month IX, night of the 27th, in the middle watch, | the child was born.
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.original: iti.ŠE 30 GE6 6 SAG GE6 30 | ina IGI ŠUR GIGIR ša2 SI 1 KUŠ3 | 6 ina ZALAG2 lu2.TUR a-lid
quotations.translation: Month XII 30, night of the 6th, beginning of night, the moon | was 1 cubit west of the northern ... of the Chariot (β Tauri), | On the 6th in the last part of night, the child was born.
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88, 1–164.

quotations.original: GE₆ 23 ina ZALAG₂ 30 ar₂ AN 1 KUŠ₃ ana NIM GUB
quotations.translation: Night of the 23rd, last part of the night, the moon stood 1 cubit behind Mars to the east.
quotations.publication: Sachs, A. J., Hunger, H. 1996. Astronomical Diaries and Related Texts from Babylonia, Vol. III. Diaries from 164 B.C. to 61 B.C. Vienna, Austria: Verlag der Österreichischen Akademie der Wissenschaften.

quotations.original:
I. THEMA MUNDI.
Mundi itaque genituram hanc esse voluerunt secuti Aesculapium et Hanubium [...]
quotations.translation:
1. THEMA MUNDI.
They [Petosiris and Nechepso] in this doctrine followed Aesculapius and Hanubius.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: nam in masculino signo collocatus Soli trigonica se radiatione coniungit
quotations.translation: for, located in a masculine sign, he relates himself in trine aspect to the Sun.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Lunae tarnen per quadratum testimonium perhibet;
quotations.translation: she is in square aspect to the Moon.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: praesertim cum CCC milibus annorum maior apocatastasis, id est redintegratio, per pyrosin aut per cataclysmum fieri consueverit
quotations.translation: the return of the stars to their places after fire and flood is supposed to happen only after 300,000 years.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Post Saturnum luppiter accepit temporum potestatem
quotations.translation: After Saturn, Jupiter received the rulership of time
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: sed et ambo lamina, id est Sol et Luna, radios suos in hoc signum miserint
quotations.translation: and the luminaries-the Sun and Moon-send their rays toward this sign.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si vero Saturno per diem in horoscopo constitute Mars alium geniturae possederit cardinem vel in anafora cardinis fuerit, multorum malorum significat adventum
quotations.translation: If Saturn is on the ascendant by day and Mars is on another angle or the anafora of an angle, this indicates many evils
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si vero Lunam de quadrato vel de diametro viderit aut si Luna in eadem parte fuerit qua ipse constituta, sterilitatem filiorum faciet;
quotations.translation: If Saturn is in conjunction with the Moon or in opposition or square aspect to her, this will make the native sterile.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: [...], praesertim si in malignae stellae vel signo vel loco vel finibus fuerit inventus.
quotations.translation: [...] especially if he is in the house or terms of a malefic planet.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si luppiter in primo cardine partiliter id est in parte horoscopi fuerit constitutes, in his praesertim signis, in quibus gaudet, vel in suis domiciliis vel in suis finibns vel in altitudine sua, faciet nobiles gloriosos magnis semper praepositos civitatibus, interdum magnarum civitatum decem primos pro mensura geniturae, bonos venustos benivolos laetos divites, praesertim si per diem in horoscopi partibus fuerit inventus et si nulla malivola stella sic ei posito ex aliqua parte restiterit.
quotations.translation: If Jupiter is found exactly on the first angle, that is, on the ascendant, especially in those signs in which he rejoices or in his own house or terms or in his exaltation, he will make the native high-born, famous, always ruling great states, perhaps the first ten of the great states. He will also make him, according to the computation of the chart, virtuous, charming, benevolent, cheerful, rich, especially if Jupiter is in this house by day and no malefic planet is in aspect.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: nam in terrenis signis constitutus feris faciet obici
quotations.translation: For if Mars is in an earth sign the native is forced to meet wild beasts;
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: in solidis vero opprimi a ruina facit aut <per> praecipitia iactari
quotations.translation: in fIxed signs he is crushed by ruins or thrown over a precipice;
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: [ḪA.LA] SAG-ti mul2.lu2.ḪUN.GA2 šum3-šu2 : ša2-ni-tum ḪA.LA MUL2.MUL2 šum3-šu2 | [3-tu]m ḪA.LA mul2.MAŠ.MAŠ šum3-šu2 : 4-ni!-tum ḪA.LA mul2.ALLA šum3-šu2 | [5-i-t]um ḪA.LA mul2.UR.A šum3-šu2 : 6-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.ABSIN šum3-šu2 | [7-i]-tum ḪA.LA mul2.GIŠ.RIN2 šum3-šu2 : 8-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.GIR2.TAB šum3-šu2 | [9]-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.PA šum3-šu2 : 10-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.MAŠ2 šum3-šu2 | 11-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.GU šum3-šu2 : 12-i-tum ḪA.LA mul2.ZIB šum3-šu2 | PAP 12 UZU.MEŠ ḪA.LA ša2 mul2.LU ša2 d.30 u d.UTU ina lib3-bi DIB.MEŠ
quotations.translation: The name of the first [portion] is Aries. The name of the second portion is Taurus. | The name of the [third] portion is Gemini. The name of the fourth portion is Cancer. |The name of the [fifth] portion is Leo. The name of the sixth portion is Virgo. |  The name of the [seventh] portion is Libra. The name of the eighth portion is Scorpio. | The name of the [ninth] portion is Sagittarius. The name of the tenth portion is Capricornus. | The name of the eleventh portion is Aquarius. The name of the twelfth portion is Pisces. | Total: 12 ominous parts, portion(s) of Aries which the Moon and the Sun will pass through.
quotations.publication: Sachs, A., 1952. Babylonian Horoscopes, Journal of Cuneiform Studies 6.

quotations.original: iu aquosis constitutus naufragio submergit;
quotations.translation: in watery signs he perishes in a boat;
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In terrestribus vero signis in desertis locis faciet occidi, multiplici tarnen prius periculorum continuatione turbatos.
quotations.translation: But in earth signs they die in desert places after being involved in many various dangers.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In igneis vero signis constitutus exuri faciet.
quotations.translation: In fiery signs he is burned up.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In constantibus vero signis et quae modicae sunt vocis posita, in nocturna scilicet genitura, faciet multiplici studio veneratores amicos imperatorum
quotations.translation: Venus in fixed signs or those with small voice in a nocturnal chart will make devoted friends of emperors, who make and invent things that please royalty;
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si enim hunc locum tenuerit in tropicis signis constituta vel squamosis vel [aut] erraticis, et cum ea Mars fuerit aut se illi per diametrum aut de quadrato forti radiatione coniunxerit, facit inpuros libidinosos infames.
quotations.translation: If she is in tropical, scaly, or mutable signs, and Mars is with her or in opposition or square aspect, the natives are oversexed, impure, and of ill repute.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.translation: For the lord of the (lot of the) Daimon and of the place of intellect, Mercury, was in opposition to itself, that is, in Gemini.
quotations.publication: (GH L 123,I)

quotations.translation: Ascendant in Leo, 13 degrees, house of the Sun, terms of Saturn, decan 2

quotations.translation: And so too here did the planets happen to be in two-bodied (zodiac signs).
quotations.publication: (GH L 134,VI)

quotations.original: ὁ τοιοῦτος ἔνδοξος, ἐξουσιαστικός· ἐδορυφορήθη γὰρ ὁ Ἥλιος ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγαθοποιῶν καὶ εὑρέθη ἐπικείμενος τῷ κλήρῳ τῆς τύχης σὺν τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ.
quotations.translation: The one with such (a nativity) is glorious, powerful: for the Sun was body-guarded by the benefic (planets) and was found located in the lot of fortune with the house-master.
quotations.publication: (GH L 101,III)

quotations.original: ἐν δὲ τῷ αὐτῷ ἔτει καὶ παλλακίδας ἠλευθέρωσε διὰ τὸ εἰς τὸν περὶ δούλων τόπον Δία ὄντα παρειληφέναι ἀπὸ Ἀφροδίτης
quotations.translation: In the same year he also freed concubines on account of Jupiter, being in the place concerning slaves, receiving (as chronokrator) from Venus
quotations.publication: (GH L 111,IV)

quotations.original: Ὁ τῶν ζῳδίων κύκλος διαιρεῖται εἰς μέρη ιβʹ, καὶ καλεῖται κοινῶς μὲν ἕκαστον τῶν τμημάτων δωδεκατημόριον, ἰδίως δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐμπεριεχομένων ἀστέρων ὑφ’ ὧν καὶ διατυποῦται ἕκαστον αὐτῶν ζῴδιον.
quotations.translation: The zodiac is divided in 12 parts, and each of the sections is named a “twelfth part” generally, but after the encompassing stars through which each of them is also formed a “zodiac sign” specifically.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: DIŠ mul.SIPA.ZI.AN.NA d.Pap-sukal SUK[AL d.A-nim u INNIN]
quotations.translation: ¶ The True Shepherd of Heaven, Papsukal, the minis[ter of Anu and Ištar].
quotations.publication: Hunger, H. and Steele, J., 2019. The Babylonian Astronomical Compendium MUL.APIN. London and New York: Routledge.

quotations.original: [iti.S]IG4 4 mul2.SIPA.ZI.NA
quotations.translation: [Mon]th III, 4, 'The True Shepherd of Heaven'.
quotations.genre: schematic astronomy: 'three stars each' + rising times
quotations.publication: Horowitz, W., 2014. The Three Stars Each: The Astrolabes and Related Texts (Archiv für Orientforschung, Beiheft 33). Horn/Wien: Berger & Söhne/Institut für Orientalistik der Universität Wien.

quotations.original: Ὁ τῶν ζῳδίων κύκλος διαιρεῖται εἰς μέρη ιβʹ, καὶ καλεῖται κοινῶς μὲν ἕκαστον τῶν τμημάτων δωδεκατημόριον, ἰδίως δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐμπεριεχομένων ἀστέρων ὑφ’ ὧν καὶ διατυποῦται ἕκαστον αὐτῶν ζῴδιον.
quotations.translation: The zodiac is divided in 12 parts, and each of the sections is named a “twelfth part” generally, but after the encompassing stars through which each of them is also formed a “zodiac sign” specifically.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: ana SIG3.ḫi.a ina ŠA3 mul.lu2.ḪUN.GA2 mul.giš.RIN2 u [mu]l.SIPA.ZI.AN.NA
quotations.translation: For wool: within Aries, Libra, and Gemini.
quotations.publication: Hunger, H. 2004. Stars, Cities, and Predictions. Pp. 16–32 in Studies in the History of the Exact Sciences in Honour of David Pingree, eds. Charles Burnett, Jan Hogendijk, Kim Plofker and Michio Yano. Leiden: Brill.

quotations.original: mul.MAŠ.MAŠ mul.SIPA
quotations.translation: 'The Twins', 'The True Shepherd of Heaven' (=Mirco-Gemini)
quotations.publication: Weidner, E., 1967. Gestirn-Darstellungen auf babylonischen Tontafeln. Wien: Hermann Böhlaus Nachf.

quotations.original: ana tar-ṣi 2.13.20 LA₂-u₂ 2.40 GAR-an
quotations.translation: Opposite 2,13;20, decreasing, you put 2,40.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original: mul₂.UD.KA.DUḪ.A a-dir sin ina EN.NUN.USAN AN.MI GAR-ma
quotations.translation: The-Demon-with-the-gaping-mouth-star is dark: (it means that) Sin causes an eclipse in the evening watch.
quotations.genre: astrology and goal-year astronomy: procedure text
quotations.publication: Brack-Bernsen, Lis, and Hunger, Hermann. 2002. TU 11. A Collection of Rules for the Prediction of Lunar Phases and of Month Lengths. SCIAMVS 3: 3–90.

quotations.original: ina 8 MU.MEŠ ŠU₂ u₃ IGI GI
quotations.translation: In 8 years the setting and the appearance (of Venus) become ‘intact’.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ’ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ’ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.
quotations.translation: The word “zōidion” is uttered in two ways, according to one way as the 12th part of the zodiac, which is some interval of space marked off by either stars or points, and according to the other as the image formed from the stars according to the likeness and the position of the stars.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: TA 1 ME GI ⸢EN⸣ 1 ME 1.30
quotations.translation: After completing 1,(0) days, until 1,(0) days, (0);1,30.
quotations.publication: M. Ossendrijver, 2017, New results on a Babylonian scheme for Jupiter's motion along the zodiac, Journal of Near Eastern Studies 76, 231–247

quotations.original:
(22) ina 5 DANNA si-man 5 UŠ
(23) ᵈsin ana ᵈUTU.ŠU₂.A tu-šaḫ-ḫa-az
quotations.translation: (22) In 5 bēru time (23) you let Sin proceed 5 UŠ to the west.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ᾽ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ᾽ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.
quotations.translation: The word “zōidion” is uttered in two ways, according to one way as the 12th part of the zodiac, which is some interval of space marked off by either stars or points, and according to the other as the image formed from the stars according to the likeness and the position of the stars.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original:
(16) a-na tar-ṣi 2.12.8.53.20 LA₂-u₂ 2.42.57.46.40 GAR-an
(17) [m]im-ma ša₂ al-la 2.12.8.53.20 LA₂-u₂ i-maṭ-ṭu-u₂
(18) [E]N 2.11.51.6.40 LA₂-u₂ TA 2.12.8.53.20
(19) ⸢E₁₁⸣-ma ša₂ re-ḫi GAM 5 DU-ma KI 2.42.57.46.40
(20) [TAB]-ma GAR-an
quotations.translation: (16) Opposite 2,12;8,53,20, decreasing, you put down 2,42;57,46,40. (17) That which is less than 2,12;8,53,20, decreasing, (18) until 2,11;51,6,40, decreasing, you deduct from 2,12;8,53,20, (19) and what remains you multiply by 5, and you [add] it with 2,42;57,46,40 and (20) you put it down.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ’ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ’ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original:
(7') ṣal-pi ina KASKAL-šu₂ ina ŠA₃-šu₂ (erasure?) SE₃.AM₃ ⸢u₄⸣-[mu ša₂]
(8') ana ṣal-pi DIB-iq tam-mar ki-ma-a ⸢mu⸣-[šam-ša₂ x?]
(9') 10.45 šu-u₂ tam-mar ki BAR šu-u₂ 12 ⸢SAG⸣ [GAL-tu₂ A.RA₂ 12 DU-ma]
(10') 2.24 9.30 SAG ṭe-ri-tu₂ A.RA₂ 9.3[0 DU-ma]
(11') TA 2.24 ZI-ma
quotations.translation: (7') You place the “crossing” in its path, in its middle. [The day when] (8') it passes the “crossing”, you see how long it is tak[ing ...?] (9') (Concerning) this 10;45, you see when it is halved: (0);12, the [large] width, [you multiply by (0);12, it is] (10') (0);2,24. (0);9,30, the “pinched” width, [you multiply] by (0);9,30, [it is (0);1,30,15.] (11') You subtract it from (0);2,24.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2016, Ancient Babylonian astronomers calculated Jupiters position from the area under a time-velocity graph, Science, 351, 482-484

quotations.original:
(15') TA IGI ana UŠ 16.15 KI DU
(16') UŠ
quotations.translation: (15') From appearance (FA) to station (S1) the position proceeds 16;15, (16’) (then) it (Jupiter) becomes stationary.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2016, Ancient Babylonian astronomers calculated Jupiters position from the area under a time-velocity graph, Science, 351, 482-484

quotations.original: 24 ME nen-mud ina 32 ⸢ME⸣ 20 ⸢KI⸣-šu₂ ana ŠU₂ ⸢LA₂⸣-[is?]
quotations.translation: 24 days it (Venus) is stationary. In 32 days its position recedes to the west by 20.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original: [mu]l.SIPA.ZI.AN.NA : ŠITA2 .DAR : ša2 ina kak-ki maḫ-ṣu
quotations.translation: The True-Shepherd-of Heaven-star : ŠITA2 .DAR (=šitaddaru) : the one who is smiten with the weapon.
quotations.publication: Reiner, E., Civil, M. 1974. The Series HAR-ra = hubullu: Tablets XX-XXIV (Materials for the Sumerian Lexicon XI). Pontificium Institutum Biblicum: Rome.

quotations.original: MU.1.ME.1,34.KAM | ZIZ2 GE6 10 30 DANNA | GE6 ana ZALAG2 lu2.TUR a-lid
quotations.translation: Year 194 (S.E.), | month XI, night of the 10th, 30 (UŠ, i.e.) one bēru | remaining until sunrise, the child was born.
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.original: U4 8 ša2 30 DANNA ME ana ŠU2 šamaš2 a-lid [...]
quotations.translation: The 8th day, at one-half bēru before sunset, he was born [...].
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88, 1–164.

quotations.original: nam in curvis signis praemori facit, interdum claudos et gibberosos.
quotations.translation: In crooked signs he makes for an early death and sometimes produces cripples or hunchbacks.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: in humanis vero signis constitutus gladio facit interire.
quotations.translation: in human signs he is killed by a sword.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: sicut diximus, sine Veneris aut lovis testimonio gladiatores facit, sed eos, qui <in> conspectu populi crudeli necis atrocitate depereant.
quotations.translation: thus located without aspect of Venus or Jupiter, makes gladiators who perish in a cruel death in view of the populace.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In quadrupedibus vero signis faciet <a> bestiis comprehensos misera laceratione laniari.
quotations.translation: In four-footed signs they will be torn apart by beasts.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Sed si in horoscope <luppiter partiliter fuerit inventus, horoscopus> vero ipse sit in domo lovis [vel] Venerisque stella prospera se lovi radiatione coniungat et obstiterit Marti hac, qua diximus, radiatione grassanti, omnia haec calamitatum funera maxima parte mutantur.
quotations.translation: If Jupiter is on the ascendant but Mars himself in the house of Jupiter, and Venus favorably aspected to Jupiter and in opposition to Mars, all these deadly calamities are to a great extent changed.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si vero cum eo Mars aut Saturnus fuerint inventi aut de diametro ei oppositi aut de quadrato coniuncti, facient alienos deliros aut cardiacos aut freneticos;
quotations.translation: Mars or Saturn together with him or in opposition or square aspect makes the natives hostile, raving, delirious, or suffering from stomach disorders.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Πάλιν δὲ ἕκαστον τῶν δωδεκατημορίων διαιρεῖται εἰς μέρη λʹ, καὶ καλεῖται τὸ ἓν τμῆμα μοῖρα, ὥστε τὸν ὅλον κύκλον τῶν ζῳδίων περιέχειν ζῴδια μὲν ιβʹ, μοίρας δὲ τξʹ.
quotations.translation: And each of these twelve zodiac signs is divided in 30 parts, and a single section is called a “degree”, so that the whole zodiac comprises 12 zodiac signs, and 360 degrees.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: solus in cardinibus geniturae fuerit inventus vel in cataforis vel in anaforis eorum
quotations.translation: alone on an angle or on the anafora or catafora of an angle [= the sign before or after]
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.transliteration: ṯꜣy] pꜣ ḏd-wnw.t 1.t šꜥ pꜣ ḏd-wnw.t 4.t ny-sw | Km.t
quotations.translation: From the 1st hour of until the 4th hour, it belongs to | Egypt.
quotations.date: 2nd century CE; text from 7th cent. BCE
quotations.publication: R. A. Parker, 1959, A Vienna Demotic Papyrus on Eclipse- and Lunar Omina , Providence .

quotations.original: magnos potentes nobiles faciet et quibus committantur maximae potestates, praesertim si fuerit in domo sua aut in altitudine sua aut in domo lovis constitutus et si locus Fortunae partiliter et per computum diligenter inventus in aliquo cardine fuerit collocatus.
quotations.translation: high position and great power are indicated, especially if she is in her own house or exaltation, or the house of Jupiter, or if the Lot of Fortune is located (with most careful measurement) on any angle.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: In constantibus vero signis et quae modicae sunt vocis posita, in nocturna scilicet genitura, faciet multiplici studio veneratores amicos imperatorum, facientes aliquid tale et invenientes, quod ad venias regias pertineat
quotations.translation: Venus in fixed signs or those with small voice in a nocturnal chart will make devoted friends of emperors, who make and invent things that please royalty;
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si enim hunc locum tenuerit in tropicis signis constituta vel squamosis vel [aut] erraticis, et cum ea Mars fuerit aut se illi per diametrum aut de quadrato forti radiatione coniunxerit, facit inpuros libidinosos infames.
quotations.translation: If she is in tropical, scaly, or mutable signs, and Mars is with her or in opposition or square aspect, the natives are oversexed, impure, and of ill repute.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: facit etiam frequenter oratores et advocates, praesertim si in hoc loco vel in suis signis vel in ceteris vocalibus signis fuerit inventus.
quotations.translation: Often he [Mercury] makes orators and lawyers, especially if in this house he is in his own sign or in other voiced signs.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Si vero in hoc loco matutinus fuerit inventus, faciet sacerdotes divinos haruspices augures mathematicos astrologos medicos, et quibus ex istis artibus et institutis vitae subsidia quaerantur.
quotations.translation: Mercury in this house in a morning rising makes priests, haruspices, augurs, astrologers, astronomers, physicians, and such as gain their livelihood from that kind of skill.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Mercurius cum Iove partiliter in horoscopo constitutus in diurna genitura faciet claros et gloriosos
quotations.translation: Mercury conjunct Jupiter on the ascendant in a day-chart make [the native] famous and glorious
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Τὰ μὲν οὖν δωδεκατημόρια ἴσα ἐστὶ κατὰ τὸ μέγεθος· διόπτρᾳ γὰρ διῄρηται ὁ τῶν ζῳδίων κύκλος εἰς ιβʹ μέρη ἴσα.
quotations.translation: Thus, the twelfth parts are equal in size: for the zodiac has been divided by means of the dioptra into 12 equal parts.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Si vero in hoc loco fuerit minuta luminibus et Saturnus in parte vel in signo horoscopi fuerit constitutus, perficit repentinis oculorum vulneribus caecitatem.
quotations.translation: If the Moon is waning in this house and Saturn is on the degree or in the sign of the ascendant, this indicates blindness from sudden wounds in the eyes.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Quodsi deficiens lumine in hoc loco constituta in diurna genitura ad Solem feratur, processu temporis potentiam gloriam administrationesque largitur.
quotations.translation: If [the moon] is found waning in this place in a day-chart moving toward the sun, in the course of time [the native] achieves power, glory and high positions.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Babylonii enim [in] duodecatemoriis summam decretorum tribuunt, Ptolomaeus vero antisciis, nos utrisque.
quotations.translation: The Babylonians attribute all the forecast to the duodecatemorion; but Ptolemy to the antiscia, and we to both.
quotations.publication: Firmicus Maternus. 1897. Ivlii Firmici Materni Matheseos Libri VIII, ed. W. Kroll, F. Skutsch. Stuttgart: B. G. Teubner.

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ’ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ’ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.
quotations.translation: The word “zōidion” is uttered in two ways, according to one way as the 12th part of the zodiac, which is some interval of space marked off by either stars or points, and according to the other as the image formed from the stars according to the likeness and the position of the stars.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ’ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ’ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Διχῶς δὲ λέγεται ζῴδιον, καθ’ ἕνα μὲν τρόπον τὸ ιβʹον μέρος τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ὅ ἐστι διάστημά τι τόπου ἢ ἄστροις ἢ σημείοις ἀφοριζόμενον, καθ’ ἕτερον δὲ τὸ ἐκ τῶν ἀστέρων εἰδωλοπεποιημένον κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα καὶ τὴν θέσιν τῶν ἀστέρῶν.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: ŠU2 ana DU3-ka ki si-man ša2 GE6 DU al-la LA2 ša2 GE6 DIRI LA2 ša2 G[E6 TA GE6 DU NIM]
quotations.translation: In order for you to construct ŠU2. If the time by which the night has progressed exceeds the length of night you subtract the length of ni[ght from (the time by which) the night has progressed].
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2012. Babylonian Mathematical Astronomy: Procedure Texts. New York: Springer.

quotations.original: ἐὰν ἐπὶ τοῦ τμήματος τῶν δύο ζῳδίων τις τύχῃ, δυνατώτερός ἐστι καὶ ἀμέτρητος περὶ τὰς ἐνεργείας
quotations.translation: If one (of the planets) happens to be at the dividing point between two zodiac signs, it is more powerful and immense in its activity.
quotations.source: Sarapion of Alexandria, Various Names for Configurations of the Stars
quotations.publication: CCAG VIII.4

quotations.original: Πάλιν δὲ ἕκαστον τῶν δωδεκατημορίων διαιρεῖται εἰς μέρη λʹ, καὶ καλεῖται τὸ ἓν τμῆμα μοῖρα, ὥστε τὸν ὅλον κύκλον τῶν ζῳδίων περιέχειν ζῴδια μὲν ιβʹ, μοίρας δὲ τξʹ.
quotations.translation: And each of these twelve zodiac signs is divided in 30 parts, and a single section is called a “degree”, so that the whole zodiac comprises 12 zodiac signs, and 360 degrees.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Τὰ δὲ κατηστεριγμένα ζῴδια οὔτε ἴσα ἐστὶ κατὰ τὸ μέγεθος οὔτε ἐξ ἴσων ἀστέρων συνέστηκεν οὔτε πάντα ἐκπληροῖ τοὺς ἰδίους τόπους τῶν δωδεκατημορίων· ἀλλ’ ἃ μὲν ἐλλείπει, καθάπερ ὁ Καρκίνος· μικρὸν γὰρ τόπον ἐπέχει τοῦ ἰδίου τόπου· ἃ δὲ ὑπερπίπτει καὶ μέρη τινὰ τῶν προηγουμένων καὶ τῶν ἑπομένων ζῳδίων ἐπιλαμβάνει, καθάπερ ὁ Λέων· (...)
quotations.translation: But the constellations are not equal in size, nor are they put together from an equal amount of stars, nor do they all fill up their own spaces of the twelfth parts. Rather, some fall short, such as Cancer: for it occupies a small space of its own space; but others extend beyond and lay hold of some part of the preceding and the following zodiac signs, such as Leo; (...)
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.
quotations.comment: The manuscripts have “καθάπερ ὁ Λέων”, “such as Leo”. Aujac has “καθάπερ ἡ Παρθένος”, “such as Virgo”.

quotations.original: Ὁ δὲ ἥλιος ἐνιαυτῷ διαπορεύεται τὸν ζῳδιακὸν κύκλον· (...)
quotations.translation: The sun goes through the zodiac in a year: (...)
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: (...) ἔστι γὰρ ἐνιαύσιος χρόνος, ἐν ᾧ ὁ ἥλιος περιπορεύεται τὸν ζῳδιακὸν κύκλον καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αὐτοῦ σημείου ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ σημεῖον ἀποκαθίσταται.
quotations.translation: (...) for it is the time of a year, in which the sun goes around the zodiac and is returned from the same point to the same point.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Καὶ ἡ μὲν μοῖρα τξʹον μέρος ἐστὶ τοῦ ζῳδιακοῦ κύκλου, ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα τξεʹον καὶ δʹον μέρος ὡς ἔγγιστα τοῦ ἐνιαυσιαίου χρόνου.
quotations.translation: Also, the degree is a 360th part of the zodiac, and the day as close as possible to a 365th and a 4th part of the time of a year.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: (9') [TA UŠ] (10') 4 KI ana ar₂-šu₂ LA₂-is-ma ana ME E
quotations.translation: (9') [From the station] (10') the position (of Jupiter) moves backward 4 (UŠ), then it rises to daylight (Acronychal Rising).
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2016, Ancient Babylonian astronomers calculated Jupiters position from the area under a time-velocity graph, Science, 351, 482-484

quotations.original: [ina] ⸢6.42⸣ ME.MEŠ TA IGI ana IGI 30 KI DU
quotations.translation: In 6,42 days from appearance to appearance the position (of Jupiter) goes forward by 30.
quotations.publication: Ossendrijver, M. 2016, Ancient Babylonian astronomers calculated Jupiters position from the area under a time-velocity graph, Science, 351, 482-484

quotations.original: Αἱ πᾶσαι οὖν ἡμέραι τούτων τῶν δʹ χρόνων συντιθέμεναι ποιοῦσι τξεʹ δʹʹ, ὅσαιπερ ἦσαν αἱ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ.
quotations.translation: All the days of these 4 time periods then, when put together, make 365 and a 4th, as much as those of the year were.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Διαιρεῖται δὲ ὁ ἐνιαύσιος χρόνος εἰς μέρη δʹ, ἔαρ θέρος φθινόπωρον καὶ χειμῶνα.
quotations.translation: The time of a year is divided into 4 parts: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Διαιρεῖται δὲ ὁ ἐνιαύσιος χρόνος εἰς μέρη δʹ, ἔαρ θέρος φθινόπωρον καὶ χειμῶνα.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Οἱ δὲ μεταξὺ χρόνοι τῶν τροπῶν καὶ τῶν ἰσημεριῶν τοῦτον διαιροῦνται τὸν τρόπον.
quotations.translation: The times between the solstices and the equinoxes are divided in this way.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: Οἱ δὲ μεταξὺ χρόνοι τῶν τροπῶν καὶ τῶν ἰσημεριῶν τοῦτον διαιροῦνται τὸν τρόπον.
quotations.translation: The times between the solstices and the equinoxes are divided in this way.
quotations.publication: Geminus. 1975. Géminos, Introduction aux Phénomènes, ed. G. Aujac. Paris: Les Belles Lettres.

quotations.original: ὄγδοος τόπος θανάτου· παντοῖαι θεωρίαι· οἱ ἀγαθοποιοὶ παρόντες ἐν τούτῳ τῷ τόπῳ ἄπρακτοι καὶ ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ἀμέριστοι τῶν ἰδίων ἀγαθῶν
quotations.translation: Eighth place, of death, all kinds of theoretical considerations: when the benefic (planets) are present in this place, they are ineffectual and weak and do not partake in their own benefits.

quotations.original: iti.KIN 13 KI ŠU2 20 | AN.GE6 30 al šal ḪAB-rat | DIRI GAR-an ad2 E3-a | ina ZIB.ME
quotations.translation: Month VI, the 13th, with the setting of the sun | a lunar eclipse, exceeding 1/3 of the disk, | occured; (the moon) was darkly when it rose | in Pisces.
quotations.date: 1st century BCE (date of birth in horoscope: 243 S.E. I.20 = -68 Apr.16)
quotations.publication: Rochberg, F. 1998. Babylonian Horoscopes. Transactions of the American Philosophical Society, 88.

quotations.translation: Month VI, the 13th, with the setting of the sun | a lunar eclipse, exceeding 1/3 of the disk, | occured; (the moon) was darkly when it rose | in Pisces.
